#### Transit Time and
 Price Finder

 
 

 

 
# Transit Time Finder

 
The Transit Time Finder provides you with the delivery date
 for a selected service.
 
You are required to select the Blue Dart service required
 by you, the Origin and Destination City and the pick up date and
 time below.
 

 To confirm if the service required by you is available, for the
 origin and destination selected, please check with our Location Finder. For detailed
 information on our services, refer to our Service Guide.
 
 

 NOTE 1 : The scheduled delivery date given is subject to
 the Terms And Conditions Of Carriage, details of which are
 available in our Service
 Guide.
 
 

 NOTE 2 : Some locations in or around the city could be out
 of delivery area and may require extra time for delivery - Contact Customer Service.
 
 

 NOTE 3 : Transit Time arrived at are on best estimate
 basis and it is advisable to Contact
 Customer Service for your definite shipping needs.
 
 

 NOTE 4 : Non documents shipments are subject to stricter
 customs, excise, and/or regulatory checks which may cause delays
 - please refer further to disclaimer section.
 

 

 
# Price Finder

 
The Price Finder helps you to calculate your shipping
 charges for your service type needs.
 
Charges will be based on the weight of the shipment in kgs
 or fractions thereof and may be assessible either on the gross
 weight of the shipment or the volume/dimensional weight of the
 shipment - whichever is higher.
 
The chargeable weight may be expressed as fractions of a
 kg. such as 0.25 kgs or 0.5 kgs and may go upto 9999 kgs.
 

 If you wish to contact our centralized customer service click
 here.
 
 

 For information on Fuel Surcharge click here.
 
 

 For information on Remote Area Service (International) click
 here (http://www.dhl.co.in/publish/in/en/eshipping/remote_area_service.high.html).
